result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows noticeable vertical misalignment between cards, and elements on the right edge are truncated in ways that look unintentional rather than like a clean carousel overflow.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is vertically offset compared to the other cards — its image starts lower and its title/price sit lower than 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...', making the row look broken and uneven.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a consistent fixed image height and top alignment so images, titles, and delivery prices align on the same baselines.

issues.description: The third card's restaurant name is hard-truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, and its content is clipped at the screen edge in a way that looks like a rendering cutoff rather than intentional carousel peeking.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis for overflowing names and ensure the card width/peek amount is consistent so partially visible cards look intentional.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a sliver, giving little visual affordance of what it is.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so the next chip peeks with enough width to hint at its label, or add a gradient fade to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Inconsistent time-badge placement in the 'Fastest near you' cards: badges sit at different vertical positions (bottom-left on first card, lower on second, higher on third), adding to the uneven appearance.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the delivery-time badge to the same corner and offset within every card image.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the tab bar without visible spacing or scroll hint, and its title/details are not visible, which can look broken on first glance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom padding under the last content item and consider a subtle scroll indicator so clipped content clearly reads as scrollable.
